mutations.before: if (fingerprint(st) !== reviewed) return refused(`${rel} changed since the digest`);
mutations.after: if (!reviewed.startsWith(`size:${st.size}:`)) return refused(`${rel} changed since the digest`);
mutations.because: Grok PT-8d 2 (owner, 2026-10-11): apply refuses a render whose lstat size and mtime differ from the reviewed stamp. Comparing the size alone accepts a file rewritten with the same size.
command: a render whose time or size differs from the reviewed stamp is refused and never read

mutations.because: Grok PT-8d 3 (owner, 2026-10-11): a render over 512 MiB is refused and listed. The cap must be exact: one byte over is refused.
command: a render over the cap is refused with its size and never read; one at the cap is read

mutations.before: if (st.isSymbolicLink()) return refused(`${rel} is a symlink; the importer never follows one`);
mutations.after: if (st.isSymbolicLink() && rel === "") return refused(`${rel} is a symlink; the importer never follows one`);
mutations.because: A symlinked render is refused as a link and never followed, even when the link's own stamp is in the digest.
command: a symlinked file is refused as a link, although its own stamp is the reviewed one

mutations.because: A file under a symlinked directory is not the file the output tree holds: without the parent check the bytes come from wherever the link points.
command: a file under a symlinked directory is refused, although its stamp is the reviewed one

mutations.because: D225: a file the digest named and that is gone was removed after the review. That is a change, not an absent file.
command: a file that is not there is absent, unless the digest named it: then it changed
